title: Sega pulls Total War: Shogun 2 remaster from sale following disastrous launch
script:
Sega removed Total War: Shogun 2 Complete Edition from digital storefronts after a disastrous launch.
Players complained about technical bugs and low-quality visual artifacts throughout the strategy game.
The community identified specific textures that suggest the developer used AI for lazy upscaling.
This remaster launched on Tuesday to bundle the 2011 base game with all its expansions.
The game currently holds overwhelmingly negative reviews on Steam following the botched release.
Sega has not yet announced a date for when the game will return to storefronts.
Would you accept AI-upscaled graphics in your favorite classic games?
